name: Hur
bio: Hur is an important associate of Moses during Israel's wilderness journey. When the Amalekites attacked Israel and Joshua led the troops into battle, Hur joined Aaron in standing on the hilltop, supporting Moses' arms when they grew weary from holding them up in prayer, helping secure Israel's victory (Exodus 17:10-12). Later, when Moses went up Mount Sinai, he left Hur together with Aaron in charge of settling matters for the people (Exodus 24:14), showing Hur to be one of Moses' most deeply trusted core associates.
